entries.text: Result files now always record the timings that Power@Size and throughput are recomputed from, together with the executed stream count, and the compliance class stored in a result is informational. A TPC result at a standard scale that is not a full specification run keeps its scores, and the results corpus and the Explorer pipeline recompute every score, including the combined QphH and QphDS composites, from timings.

Public admission checks validation evidence consistently, power tests without throughput exclude refresh timings from partial scores, and composite scores use successful streams and the scale-specific minimum.
